phase: Phase 10C - forward monitoring production authority v3

authority_model.plan: protected producer event derived from the current paper_candidate Decision, exact Final v2 artifact, current no-taint state and registered provider
authority_model.provider: versioned descriptor freezes calendar, vintage policy and availability contract
authority_model.source: content-addressed dated raw cross-sectional observations only
authority_model.observation: RankIC, net return, drawdown, effective N, status and kill reasons recomputed by the producer
authority_model.revision: append-only DataRevisionRecorded event; original-as-observed and restated views remain separate
authority_model.discovery: forward sources, observations and revisions are monitoring-only and excluded from discovery projection

frozen_plan_fields: transform, cost, regime and policy hashes

validation.command: python -m pytest -q Phase 10C, legacy forward/final and ledger closure tests
python -m ruff format --check and python -m ruff check for Phase 10C files
python -m pytest -q revision original/restated discovery-isolation test after final assertion

red_team: a final quality boolean without a current paper_candidate Decision cannot register a plan
a forward_start before registration or final completion is rejected
late final taint invalidates the current plan view and blocks new observations
observation API exposes no caller metric parameters
period reuse and historical backfill are rejected
frozen RankIC, net-return and drawdown kill rules execute deterministically
generic plan, observation and revision event forgery is rejected
provider correction cannot overwrite the original source or original-as-observed view
forward appends do not alter the discovery projection hash
no forward success claim is emitted before or after minimum N; status remains monitoring-only
known_unrelated_baseline_failure: test_tracked_release_manifest_matches_deterministic_rebuild reads user-owned problem.md and was reproduced before Phase 1
limitations: v2 forward artifacts remain readable for compatibility but do not gain v3 producer authority
restatement changes only a monitoring view and never rewrites the original observation event
forward_track or monitoring status does not claim forward success or live readiness
no broker, order, live-trading or automatic discovery import path is introduced
